276410576.description: This lot includes six assorted raw mineral and crystal specimens with natural formations. Specimens include a dark brown transparent smoky quartz crystal, a translucent elongated clear quartz crystal, a green striated opaque tourmaline crystal, a rough pinkish-red beryl (possibly rubellite) with a raw surface, a clear flaky rectangular mica sheet, and a white quartz matrix with black tourmaline needle-like inclusions. All pieces are unpolished and show natural rough edges. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes. Samples up to ~2in long.
